svg.title: Calculations belong in a calculation engine
svg.desc: Same 15 numeric zakat tasks: deterministic rules 15 correct, original LFM3 12, Barakah candidate 11. Full numeric comparison: original 36 of 40, candidate 32 of 40. Absolute tolerance 0.01. Sixty conceptual responses per model are unreviewed. Not evidence of fine-tuning superiority.

g.text: Calculations belong in a calculation engine.
Same 15 numeric zakat tasks · correct answers · absolute tolerance 0.01
Full numeric benchmark — not just zakat
60 conceptual responses per model remain unreviewed.
Narrow rules evidence. No fine-tuning superiority demonstrated.
Source: preserved processed run scores · no inference rerun · docs/assets/PROVENANCE.md
